advisories.summary: Mandatory release for node operators. It embeds Sepolia and Mainnet Karst timestamps, and --syncmode.offset-el-safe now defaults to 12h for execution-layer sync.
advisories.action: Upgrade before the Karst time for your chain, and run op-reth. op-geth cannot follow Karst. Pass --syncmode.offset-el-safe=0 to keep the previous offset.

advisories.summary: Removes the request-response p2p sync client. After Karst, this release uses getPayloadV5, which earlier op-reth does not support.
advisories.action: Use op-reth v2.3.2 or later with this release. The request-response p2p sync client is gone.

advisories.summary: Fixes derivation against an execution client that prunes historical block bodies, including op-reth with --minimal or --prune.bodies.distance.

Mandatory for Mode, Metal, and Zora nodes that use the built-in network configs, because the embedded Karst gas setting was wrong on v1.19.2 and earlier. OP Mainnet is unaffected. Unknown keys in a custom superchain registry now fail startup.
advisories.action: Upgrade Mode, Metal, and Zora nodes that use the built-in configs. Remove unmodeled keys from a custom registry before upgrading, or startup will fail.

advisories.summary: Patch release. --l2.follow.source.rpc-timeout is now a registered flag. It previously failed as unknown, and the effective timeout was already 10s unless you set it.
advisories.action: Operators on Sepolia OP Stack chains must upgrade to op-node v1.19.5 or later before the Glamsterdam hardfork on October 6, 2026.

advisories.summary: cross_unsafe_l2 is removed from optimism_syncStatus and from eth.SyncStatus. It mirrored unsafe_l2. Required for World Chain operators on the built-in chain configs.
advisories.action: Read unsafe_l2 instead of cross_unsafe_l2. The message-safety level named cross-unsafe is unchanged.

advisories.summary: Production-build dependency cleanup. No runtime behavior or configuration change.

Recommended for sequencer operators, particularly those running with --l2.follow.source. op-node refuses to start when a rollup config activates Jovian or a later hardfork at the same timestamp as the fork before it, unless that timestamp is at or before genesis. It also rejects a config that schedules Jovian, Karst, or Lagoon without its predecessor, or before it. No chain in the embedded superchain registry is affected.
advisories.action: Correct a custom rollup config that violates that rule before upgrading. Sepolia OP Stack nodes must be on v1.19.5 or later before the Glamsterdam hardfork on October 6, 2026.
